label: About
title: About Acid Felt Poster Hall
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 75 recent saved-signal files and 71 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @archivepilled: Nicolò Pucci di Benisichi, 'Biliardo con aereo' (2026) and Anchor image material 2, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Acid Felt Poster Hall: A torn poster wall inside a public billiard hall, seen as a shallow frontal plate: one acid-green horizontal smear cuts nearly edge-to-edge across the upper half, while a tilted turquoise felt trapezoid drives from lower left to mid-right. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against acid-green upper wall rupture, turquoise billiard felt plane, and left torn paper aperture.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
